purpose: Represent deliberate evidence-dependent waiting with explicit wake/cancel/timeout boundaries while keeping effect retry and authority revalidation separate.

decision_rules.property: waiting is an active lifecycle truth, not completion
wake requires represented satisfaction of the declared wake condition
timeout ends the wait horizon but does not authorize retry
time-based wake uses the declared wake time rather than inventing an external observation
decision_rules.decision: wake_condition.type=TIME and now >= wake_condition.at -> WAKE_READY unless cancellation already occurred

decision_rules.property: wake and deadline ordering is occurrence-sensitive
decision_rules.decision: an observed wake before/equal deadline may become WAKE_READY even when evaluated later; a wake observed after the deadline resolves TIMEOUT_REACHED unless Host policy explicitly creates a new wait

decision_rules.property: wake does not imply effect settlement or current authority
open-ended waits are representable without universal timeout ceremony
decision_rules.decision: deadline_at may be absent; whether that is acceptable is a caller/Host consequence boundary

verification_boundary: represented wait/wake/time consistency only; no external event authenticity, timer liveness, settlement, current authority, or timeout-policy correctness claim
